MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

4. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed

   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
